meta_title: Sticker Prompts for GPT Image 2 — Turn Photos Into Cute Stickers
meta_description: Copy-paste sticker prompts for GPT Image 2. Upload a photo, generate kawaii / die-cut / chibi / holographic stickers. Etsy-ready packs and Instagram cute styles.
intro_long: 13 tested GPT Image 2 prompts that turn any photo into ready-to-print stickers — kawaii chibi self-portraits, die-cut Etsy packs, and holographic foil designs.

how_it_works.title: Upload a clear photo or describe the subject
how_it_works.body: Best results: 1024px+ close-up, single subject, clean background. Logos and pets work too.

how_it_works.title: Pick a sticker style
how_it_works.body: Choose chibi for cute selfies, die-cut for Etsy packs, holographic for premium feel, or messaging pack.

how_it_works.title: Generate at the right size and aspect
how_it_works.body: Square 1:1 with transparent background for die-cut prints, 512×512 PNG for Telegram/WhatsApp packs.

why_use.title: Chibi & kawaii proportions stay on-model
why_use.body: GPT Image 2 nails the big-head small-body ratio, oversized eyes, and pastel palettes that make stickers read as cute, not just cropped portraits.

why_use.title: Transparent background prompts that actually work

tips.q: How do I make stickers with ChatGPT?
tips.a: Open GPT Image 2 Studio, upload a clear photo, paste a sticker prompt that includes 'die-cut sticker, bold white outline, transparent background', and generate at 1:1 square. The output is a print-ready sticker — no Photoshop background removal needed.

Use: 'Chibi sticker of [subject], oversized head and big sparkling eyes, tiny body, pastel palette, thick white die-cut outline, transparent background, kawaii style, no text.' Add `preserve facial features` if you need it to look like the uploaded person.

tips.q: How do I create a sticker pack with AI?
tips.a: Pick a theme (planner, motivational quotes, kawaii animals) and generate 6-12 stickers with the same style modifiers — same outline width, palette, and proportions. Our Etsy Seller Pack sub-scene includes tested templates that keep visual consistency across the full sheet.

tips.q: Can GPT Image 2 make transparent stickers?
tips.a: Yes — explicitly request 'transparent background, die-cut sticker, bold white outline, no surrounding scene' in the prompt. GPT Image 2 outputs a clean PNG ready for Etsy, Redbubble, or Telegram pack import without manual masking.

faq.q: How do I make stickers with GPT Image 2 from my photo?
faq.a: Upload a clear face/close-up photo to GPT Image 2 Studio, paste a sticker prompt that includes 'die-cut sticker, bold white border, transparent background, kawaii chibi style', and the model returns a sticker-ready image. For Telegram/WhatsApp packs, ensure the prompt asks for 512×512 transparent PNG.

faq.q: What are some good sticker ideas for AI?
faq.a: Top viral categories: (1) cute self portrait (turn yourself into chibi), (2) baby cuteness (motherhood trend), (3) reaction emojis, (4) motivational quote stickers, (5) kawaii animal pack. We have 13 tested templates covering each.

faq.q: Can I sell GPT Image 2 generated stickers on Etsy or Redbubble?
faq.a: Yes — generated images are typically usable for commercial purposes under Studio's terms. For Etsy/Redbubble pack sales, generate at 2K resolution, ensure transparent background, and remove any text artifacts. See our 'Etsy seller pack' sub-section for tested templates.

faq.q: What's the best sticker prompt for ChatGPT / GPT Image 2?
faq.a: Reliable template: 'Create a die-cut sticker of [subject]. Style: bold thick white outline, kawaii chibi proportions, pastel color palette, simple shapes, transparent background. Format: square sticker, centered subject, no text.' Adjust subject and style modifiers.

faq.q: How to find sticker prompts on Instagram?
faq.a: Search hashtags like #stickerprompt, #aisticker, or #chibiselfie. Top creators post tested prompts in comments (Priyanka Singh, Kaylyn Pham trend). Our library aggregates the most viral templates so you don't have to dig through Reels.
